title: A Complexity Dichotomy for Quantum Invariants of 3-Manifolds
summary: We determine the complexity of exact evaluation of the Reshetikhin--Turaev and Turaev--Viro invariants of closed connected oriented 3-manifolds, with the underlying tensor category fixed. If $\mathcal C$ is a modular category, then the Reshetikhin--Turaev invariant $Z_{\mathcal C}(M)$ can be computed in polynomial time from a framed-link surgery presentation of $M$ precisely when $\mathcal C$ is pointed; otherwise the problem is $\#\mathrm{P}$-hard.
